lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in a quasi-rectilinear grid posterior to the gill slits. In the central flank region, vertical clusters of 3-5 primary nodes are clearly visible.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal axes of large blobs, forming a grid of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light pixels above to deep shadow pixels below.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high-density population of smaller, more uniform high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the lateral flank.
